title: Flex Sheone
tagline: Fashion Fluxstore build for the Sheone catalog — theme, merchandising, and vendor admin.
overview: Flex Sheone is the Sheone fashion storefront on Fluxstore Multi Vendor: look-and-feel, catalog hierarchy, and the vendor-side pieces the brand needed in production.
problem: The brand's Woo catalog existed; the default Fluxstore theme did not look like Sheone.
solution: A dedicated Fluxstore fork with Sheone theming, category structure, and vendor admin customizations.
architecture: Flutter Fluxstore client with brand assets and module overrides; commerce data stays on the WooCommerce API.
features: Vendor admin customizations for the brand team
challenges: Matching a fashion brand's visual density without breaking Fluxstore's checkout
lessonsLearned: Keep checkout stock; spend the design budget on catalog and brand moments
futureImprovements: Lookbook-style landing modules if the catalog grows seasonal drops
results: Production Sheone mobile storefront separated from the other Flex client repos
